svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Engineering Foundations roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Git and Pull Requests: Branches and commits, Pull requests, Resolving conflicts, Releases and rollback, Cleaning up local history; 02 Working with AI Tools: Delegation levels, Giving AI context, Checking AI output, Disclosure and data rules, Red Zone work; 03 Clean Code: Naming, Small functions, Control flow, Duplication, Error handling and logging, Formatters and linters; 04 Design Principles: SOLID, Separation of concerns, Dependency injection, Composition over inheritance, Configuration and feature flags; 05 Design Thinking: Understanding the problem, Change scenarios, Trade-offs, Domain modelling, Architecture decision records; 06 APIs and Boundaries: REST API design, Validation at boundaries, Performance awareness, Caching basics; 07 Testing and Refactoring: Test levels, Writing clear tests, Testable code, Code smells, Safe refactoring; 08 Secure Engineering: Secrets, Injection and output encoding, Authorization, When to ask for a security review, OWASP Top 10; 09 Code Review: What to review, Giving feedback, The review checklist, Self-review, Reviewing AI-generated code; 10 Communication and Ownership: PR descriptions, Status and blocker updates, Handoff notes, Technical debt, Ownership
svg.text: When to ask for a security review
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
